tools.name: analyze_attendance_file
tools.description: Analyze a biometric attendance device export (ZKTeco, Hikvision, Dahua, Anviz, Suprema, FingerTec, Matrix COSEC, eSSL and similar; CSV, Excel or text, English or Arabic headers). Returns, per employee: days present, estimated absent days, late days and missing punches, plus the detected column mappi

tools.name: list_supported_attendance_formats
tools.description: List the attendance-device export header shapes the WatheeqaHR analyzer is tested against (vendor, example header row, the column it treats as the employee ID). Use it to tell a user whether their device export is likely to work before they upload it.

tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: Factual scope of WatheeqaHR: supported GCC countries, what the product does and does not do (it is not a WPS provider or a statutory filing service), plan pricing and limits, and canonical links. Use it instead of guessing when asked what WatheeqaHR offers.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_attendance_file · Private data: analyze_attendance_file · Public sink: list_supported_attendance_formats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_attendance_file · Private data: analyze_attendance_file · Public sink: list_supported_attendance_formats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
